criteria.question: sound-loom facilitation at the giant fiber with the JON -> GF contact as EM annotates it
criteria.contact: 679 EM chemical synapses, transmitter-signed, no electrical coupling (FLYCNS_JON=em)
criteria.protocol: benchmarks/auditory.py in A2-only mode: working point calibrated per run on seeds BASE+1000.., loom alone on seed BASE, loom + sound on seed BASE+1, 150 Hz on the auditory JO types
criteria.statistic: P(GF | loom + sound) - P(GF | loom), Newcombe 1998 method 10 95% interval

C1_em_facilitation.rule: BOTH parts: sound alone subthreshold (Wilson interval on its GF response probability at or below 0.3) AND the difference interval above 0; FAIL if either part fails; UNRESOLVED otherwise

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 10 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020

supersedes.why: model refrozen: the JON -> GF compound potential is calibrated per giant fiber on its own coupled afferents (run 12 measured 3.65 and 0.73 mV for a 3 mV target); w_scale 0.3 -> 0.4, the value the registered benchmark-blind rule selects (fit/select_wscale.py); the giant fiber adaptation refit under both (benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py). Criteria unchanged.
